heading: Gender Diversity and Women Empowerment Initiatives

html_bullets.point: Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Limited has transformed Acacia Palms in Goa into an all-women-run resort, showcasing a commitment to gender diversity and women empowerment in the hospitality sector.

The initiative involves women managing all aspects of the resort, promoting skill development and community upliftment, which could enhance the company's brand image and attract socially conscious customers.
